title: wg: draft-mahy-mimi-message-status-02 gaps (extension statuses, ordering, sender binding)
description:
From assay mimid-1wgh.44.11 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mimi-message-status-02.txt. Posting needs Mark's OK.
1. CDDL: $extStatus is used but no range is reserved for extensions, while unknownStatus claims all of 7..255 (§4); say which values extensions take and how a receiver treats an unknown one (keep, ignore, or show as unknown).
2. Ordering: reports can arrive out of order across a reporter's clients, and §3 allows read then unread; nothing says which report wins (latest by MLS order? by a timestamp?).
3. Scope: a report may name message IDs from another room or IDs the receiver never saw; say receivers ignore them.
4. §3 'Some status values might only be shared among the reporting user's own clients' with no way to send to own clients only in a room (needs a separate group or a targeted message).
5. Reference is content-09 (now -10; §5 examples unchanged).
